title: Saturday morning clinic runs through March
author: Priya Nandakumar
summary: Walk-in vaccines and lab draws every Saturday from 9:00 to 12:00; sick visits by appointment.
body:
The Saturday clinic is staffed by a nurse practitioner and a nurse.

Same-day sick visits are booked by phone starting at 8:00 am on Saturday.

title: Flu clinic days in November
author: Joan Whitlock
summary: Drive-up and walk-in flu shots on two Saturdays.
body: Bring a short-sleeve layer and your insurance card. No appointment needed at the clinic days listed under Clinic sessions.

title: Thanksgiving week hours
author: Dess Marlowe
summary: Open Monday to Wednesday; closed Thursday and Friday.
body: Same-day slots on Wednesday fill early. Call at 8:00 am.

title: Marcus Teague joins evening nurse-triage
author: Dess Marlowe
summary: Our after-hours call service now reaches a clinician in about 15 minutes.
body: For emergencies call 911. For after-hours questions, call the main line and follow the prompts.

title: New patient hours move to Tuesdays
author: Dess Marlowe
summary: First visits for new patients are booked Tuesday and Wednesday mornings.
body: New patients get a longer first visit so we can review records and set a plan.
